item.title: Suspect accused of sexual assault killed in SE Houston standoff after officers open fire: HPD
item.description: A suspect accused of sexual assault is now dead after being shot by officers in southeast Houston on Monday afternoon, according to the Houston Police Department.

item.title: Anthropic sues Trump administration seeking to undo 'supply chain risk' designation
item.description: San Francisco-based AI company Anthropic is suing the Trump administration, asking federal courts to reverse the Pentagon's decision designating it a "supply chain risk" over its refusal to allow unrestricted military use of its technology.

item.title: Suspect surrenders after hourslong SWAT standoff outside west Harris County home, HCSO says
item.description: After the suspect refused to comply for several hours, law enforcement was able to retrieve with the suspect by deploying a type of tear gas, known as CS gas, according to HCSO.

item.title: Higher oil prices not boosting Houston economy yet due to conflict with Iran, expert says
item.description: Normally, for Houston, when gas prices go up, the local economy is boosted; however, an expert says that is not the case this time due to the conflict in Iran.
